verdicts.reason: A: the SOLSTICE logo floats on its own in the empty middle gap, cut off from every other element. The attribution is pushed against the bottom edge, and the can hangs off-centre over a circle that is cropped at the bottom corner. B: the quote, quotation mark and attribution form one tidy column, and the can sits centred in its circle, so the layout reads left to right. Its flaws: the logo is tiny and crammed into the bottom-left, it does not line up with the 108px text column, and the circle is clipped at the top and bottom.
